Package edu.ncsu.csc216.wolf_repair.model.manager

Class WolfRepair

java.lang.Object
edu.ncsu.csc216.wolf_repair.model.manager.WolfRepair
public class WolfRepair extends Object
Manages repair sites and delegates work order operations to the active site. Uses the Singleton Pattern to provide one shared manager for the application.
Author:
Aanya Tomar

    • loadRepairSitesFromFile

      public void loadRepairSitesFromFile(String fileName)
      Loads valid repair sites from a file and appends them to the site list. Makes the first loaded site active.
      Parameters:
      fileName - name of the input file
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the file cannot be loaded

    • saveRepairSitesToFile

      public void saveRepairSitesToFile(String fileName)
      Saves all repair sites and their work orders to a file. Sites with no work orders are omitted.
      Parameters:
      fileName - name of the output file
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no site is active or the file cannot be saved

    • addNewRepairSite

      public void addNewRepairSite(String siteName, String siteCategory, int budget)
      Creates a repair site, adds it to the list, and makes it active. Site names must be unique without regard to case.
      Parameters:
      siteName - name of the new site
      siteCategory - category of the new site
      budget - nonnegative repair budget
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if site information is invalid or the name matches an existing site without regard to case

    • loadRepairSite

      public void loadRepairSite(String siteName)
      Selects the named repair site and resets the work order counter according to that site's existing work order ids.
      Parameters:
      siteName - name of the site to select
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no matching site exists

    • addWorkOrderToSite

      public int addWorkOrderToSite(String requester, String description)
      Creates and adds a Submitted work order to the active site.
      Parameters:
      requester - person filing the request
      description - description of the repair problem
      Returns:
      id of the added work order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no site is active or the work order cannot be created

    • executeCommand

      public void executeCommand(int id, Command c)
      Applies a command to a work order in the active site. Does nothing if no site is active or no matching work order exists.
      Parameters:
      id - identifier of the work order
      c - command to apply
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the command is invalid for the work order's current state
      IllegalArgumentException - if required command information is invalid

    • deleteWorkOrderById

      public void deleteWorkOrderById(int id)
      Removes a work order from the active site. Does nothing if no site is active or no matching work order exists.
      Parameters:
      id - identifier of the work order to remove

    • getWorkOrdersAsArray

      public String[][] getWorkOrdersAsArray(String stateName)
      Returns active-site work orders filtered by state. Each row contains id, state, requester, description, and technician. Work orders remain ordered by id.
      Parameters:
      stateName - state to include, or "All" to include every state
      Returns:
      array of work order information, or null if no site is active

    • getWorkOrderById

      public WorkOrder getWorkOrderById(int id)
      Finds a work order in the active site.
      Parameters:
      id - identifier to find
      Returns:
      matching work order, or null if none exists or no site is active

    • resetManager

      protected void resetManager()
      Clears the shared manager reference so the next call to getInstance() creates a fresh manager. Used to isolate tests.
